Title: SGLang security update: improving request isolation
Description: On September 9, 2026, Cloudflare notified us of cross-request KV cache exposure in its GLM-5.3 deployment on Workers AI. We worked with Cloudflare to address the request-rejection path involved and strengthen related cache-lifetime handling in disaggregated serving.

Title: I've used WordPress for 20 years, and I've stopped recommending it
Description: My agency has built more than 1,500 commercial websites, most of them on WordPress. These days I tell clients not to use it.

Title: Making Content from Discoverable Servers Easier to Discover
Description: Starting on November 16, 2026, conversations in Discoverable Servers will be easier to find for people searching the web. Admins can choose which channels are surfaced on the web. Private servers, DMs, and GDMs are not included.

Title: This Video Is a JavaScript Function. Unit-Tested. In 10 Languages. | David Pertiller
Description: A video implemented by Claude Code. No video editor, no subscription, but unit tests. My AI agent built a 15-second ad as code and shipped it in 12 versions.

Title: When UI design actually cared
Description: I recently came across Kent Sullivan’s 1996 case study on the design of the Windows 95 user interface, and reading it felt like finding a letter from a more civilized era. Sullivan joined the Windows 95 UI team in 1992 and spent years documenting how the team ran the redesign of the most widely used operating system in the world.

Title: A select should tell you something

Title: From the bottom of my heart, I salute you | janni.turunen.in
Description: Three ways to turn an open-weight model into a hypnotised Jack Dalton: a few hundred poisoned documents in pretraining, a 30-minute edit to one decoder layer, or a chat template and a quantization trick that need no training at all. Title: Hunger beats tenure: Advice for junior engineers
Description: The coding interview is dead, at least for my team at Anthropic. I've seen enough to know that it no longer provides signal. I have a spicily optimistic take: I think there's a huge opportunity for junior engineers.

Title: The post-code generation
Description:
The shoemaker had a shop.




  
  
    
      An old shoemaker in front of his shop, Bucharest, Romania, 2000.
    
  


As I watch “an agent” open a Chrome browser, start a debugging session, and try to fix a bug it just introduced, all in response to a prompt I generated with another agent, I have too much time to reflect and too many tokens to waste. I can’t help but think of the students who are now studying computer science, or who have just graduated from a technical university and are hoping to join the workforce.

Title: The system I no longer know by heart – Anton Sten
Description: When an agent does much of the production work, I stop knowing the design system by heart. The knowledge has to move out of my head and into the system.
